productionStandards.legacyPolicy: No forced migration; review stage automatically enforces production gate; draft is not ready; legacy unmarked remains compatible

actualGeometryCapture.dailyWorkflow: npm run dev (automatic event sampling after source and registry stable; instrumented projects only)
actualGeometryCapture.manualWorkflow: npm run menu → 17 → project → sample / full / final High / declared / full CapCut; optional staged diagnostic pilot/faults
actualGeometryCapture.reports: qa-out/<slug>/spatial-*/trace.json, report.json, review.html, selected original PNG and annotated SVG; layout-advice.json; qa-out/evidence-index/; quality-gate.json; precision-review.json; performance.json
actualGeometryCapture.scope: Final A–E: object-centered read-only advice, bounded reflow and pixel contribution candidates, shared browser per job, timing metrics, existing exclusive queue and exact-scope gate; diagnostic source ZIP via menu 7; actual runtime PC verification pending.

delivery: FILE CHANGE ONLY root-relative for new project, revision, Master maintenance
